basis.grid: Reported EirGrid/SONI quarter-hour observations; signed GB interconnector flows.
basis.stations: Retrospective SEMO D+1 meter half-hour averages in MW, repeated at both contained quarter-hours. Not historical live dispatch targets.
basis.availability: Historical SEMO outturn declarations where archived; null means unavailable, never today's declaration.
basis.maximum: Historical SEMO technical offer MaximumGeneration for the selected interval where archived; null means unavailable.
basis.time: Explicit Europe/Dublin offsets; source UTC timestamps aligned before local calendar grouping. DST repeats remain distinct instants.
basis.coverage: Only timestamps with all regional inputs and numeric meter outputs for every mapped unit are selectable. Other historical fields can be unavailable.
